1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **[Biotech]** **Mapping structural origins of glomerular albumin sieving** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.30.755551)
  - Cryo-electron tomography of mouse glomeruli combined with structure-resolved transport modelling indicates that the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) provides the dominant restriction to albumin via steric exclusion governed by void-network topology.
  - The model successfully accounts for whole-barrier sieving and predicts early filtration failure in Alport syndrome mice, where collagen-IV disruption remodels the GBM network.

- **[Biotech]** **Dietary phosphorus strategy for α-Klotho-deficient rats** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.17.759802)
  - Maternal low-phosphorus feeding from mating through lactation improved overall survival to weaning (92.6% vs 85.8%) and elevated the proportion of knockout survivors in a CRISPR/Cas9-generated α-Klotho-deficient rat model.
  - Continued low-phosphorus diet post-weaning supported growth, gonadal development, and natural knockout-by-knockout breeding across five generations.

- **[Biotech]** **Uncovering metabolic stress and cortisol in fetal growth restriction** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.17.759797)
  - Using a guinea pig maternal nutrient restriction model, researchers demonstrated that sustained maternal cortisol elevation and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis activation accompany fetal growth restriction alongside early acute hypoglycemia and lipid depletion.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Gilead reports positive Phase II inflammatory bowel disease data** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/19/gilead-ibs-drug-succeeds-phase-2-trial/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - An oral treatment developed by Gilead Sciences eliminated symptoms in patients with a specific type of inflammatory bowel disease in a mid-stage clinical trial.

- **[Big Pharma]** **GSK presents Phase I small cell lung cancer data at ESMO** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2112116359144276073)
  - GSK reported that ris-rez demonstrated a 61% objective response rate (ORR) in the SCLC cohort of a global Phase 1 trial, comparing favorably with the 58% ORR reported by Hansoh in the Chinese Phase 3 Artemis-008 trial, alongside noted adverse events.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- *No items populated in this category.*

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **[Biotech]** **Clene submits ALS accelerated approval filing** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112153197435662569)
  - Clene submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) seeking accelerated approval for CNM-Au8 as a treatment for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

- **[Biotech]** **UroGen accepts FDA NDA filing for UGN-103** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112152175380172812)
  - UroGen announced FDA acceptance of the NDA for UGN-103, an investigational treatment for adults with recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, with a PDUFA target action date of June 14, 2027.

- **[Biotech]** **Cidara gains priority review for Rezafungin sNDA** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112145474803364330)
  - The FDA accepted Cidara Therapeutics' supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for Rezzayo (rezafungin) with priority review for the prophylaxis of invasive fungal diseases, setting a PDUFA date in the first quarter of 2027.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Merck KGaA to acquire SpringWorks partner** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112152548983636121)
  - Merck KGaA (Darmstadt, Germany) entered an agreement to acquire Synaffix (SLN) for $20 per ADS in cash.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly signs up to $1.1 billion tech deal with Metis TechBio** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112143288958624238)
  - Eli Lilly partnered with Hong Kong-listed Metis TechBio in a drug delivery technology deal valued at up to $1.1 billion.

- **[Biotech]** **Enlivex executes major restructuring and pipeline prioritization** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2112157284356739102)
  - Enlivex announced a cost reduction plan to focus resources exclusively on the Phase 2b trial of Allocetra, winding down non-clinical R&D activities.
  - The company cut its workforce by approximately 60% and reduced management salaries by 20% to 40%, with topline six-month Phase 2b data anticipated by mid-2027.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Roche reviews German investments over cost policies** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/19/roche-investments-in-germany-gilead-bowel-disease-drug/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Roche is reviewing all future investments in Germany in response to health care cost-cutting policies, with executives citing a loss of trust.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **[Non-Commercial]** **Former GOP lawmakers warn on vaccine messaging liabilities** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/19/health-news-two-former-republican-congressmen-against-gop-vaccine-liability/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Former US Representatives Larry Bucshon and Michael Burgess argue that confusing Republican party messaging and silence on vaccines is becoming a political liability and a dealbreaker for voters ahead of the midterms.

- **[Non-Commercial]** **Immunology association divided over California research bond** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/19/california-prop-38-immunology-research-bond-oddly-specific-earmark/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Internal emails reveal the American Association of Immunologists is sharply divided over California's Proposition 38, an $8.4 billion taxpayer-funded ballot measure dedicated to immunology research.

**Worth watching:** Evolution of the regulatory landscape for AI-based medical tools and ongoing legal fallout from scientific misconduct disputes, alongside upcoming late-breaking data drops from major oncology congresses.

- Biology & Health
    - [TUDCA: A New Way of Addressing Insulin Resistance](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VaihXeBb6Qo) -- Physionic
        - TUDCA (Tauroursodeoxycholic acid) is presented as an intervention for addressing insulin resistance, with evidence showing improved insulin sensitivity in liver and muscle tissue.
        - Research indicates that endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress upregulates protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B (PTP1B), which directly impairs glucose uptake in myotubes.
        - Acute administration of TUDCA prevents endothelial dysfunction brought on by an oral glucose load.
        - Studies examine TUDCA's clinical efficacy, dosing, and safety profile across metabolic conditions and hepatobiliary disorders such as primary biliary cholangitis and cirrhosis.
    - [412 ‒ The evolving science of cancer: emerging approaches to prevention and early detection, & more](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xKB5GTsaKKs) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Dr. Siddhartha Mukherjee and Dr. Peter Attia review updates in oncology over the past 15 years, including how genetics, random mutations, inflammation, and hyperinsulinemia drive cancer risk.
        - Advanced therapeutic mechanisms are detailed, including immune checkpoint escape mechanisms, the challenges of applying CAR T cell therapy to solid tumors, and direct KRAS targeting in pancreatic cancer.
        - The conversation introduces "regenerative failure"—the age-related decline in tissue repair capacity and stem cell/T cell function—as an overarching framework for conditions like osteoarthritis.
        - Future directions in longevity and oncology are explored, including chemoprevention, AI-enabled drug discovery, and the necessity of establishing validated biomarkers for geroscience.
    - [Why AI Still Can’t Replace a Doctor’s Judgment](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/beLza0wmExA) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Allon Bloch explains that real-world clinical patients rarely conform to standardized medical textbook presentations.
        - Human clinical judgment remains indispensable in medicine, even when AI models are paired with unlimited health data.
        - The video addresses the current boundary where AI capabilities end and physician decision-making is necessary for nuanced care.
    - [Could AI Replace the EHR?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/SnhWxaE8Z4c) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Patrick E. Donohue discusses Epic’s core business model and the question of who ultimately owns patient health information.
        - The discussion evaluates whether AI foundation models could provide a superior structure for handling clinical workflows compared to legacy Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
        - Key themes highlight healthcare technology infrastructure, patient data governance, and potential AI-driven workflow transformation.
- Pure Science
    - [19 - Confused  #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xOv3RnFZUGI) -- El Jj
        - The video presents a logical tautology stating that either the video is about the law of the excluded middle (tiers-exclus), or it is not about the law of the excluded middle.
        - The single-sentence transcript demonstrates a classic application of formal propositional logic in French.
        - It serves as a self-referential example illustrating the core principle of the law of the excluded middle.
